english.note: Use 錯 as the all-purpose spoken choice when an answer, statement, or fact is incorrect.
Use this as the all-purpose choice for an objectively wrong answer, fact, calculation, or statement.
Use this short everyday form when the context makes clear that the information or answer is wrong.
Use this for a premise, conclusion, rule, or other idea that is wrong or unsound rather than fabricated.
Use this when improper means factually incorrect or containing an error.
